h1: The 5 Best Kenmore Bagged Vacuums of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Kenmore Bagged Vacuums: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: five Kenmore bagged vacuums, from the Elite upright to HEPA canisters and a hair-wrap upright, with real specs and tradeoffs.
summary: The Kenmore Elite 31150 is the best all-rounder, with triple HEPA filtration and a beltless motor. The 400 Series canister is the best complete kit, the 200 Series is the cheapest way into HEPA, and the Intuition Hair Eliminator upright suits long-haired households.
intro: Kenmore's lineup is confusing because upright and canister models share names and series numbers. The real choice is between an upright for rugs and a lightweight canister for stairs, bare floors and above-floor reach. Filtration is the second split, since only some models carry HEPA.
We reviewed Kenmore's bagged models on their listed specs: filtration, motor design, attachments and body style. Five stood out, ranked by how much they offer for the price bracket they sit in.

products.name: Kenmore Elite 31150 Pet Friendly Bagged Upright Beltless Vacuum
products.verdict: The most fully equipped Kenmore upright, with triple HEPA and no belt to replace.
products.description:
The Elite 31150 is a bagged upright with triple HEPA filtration, a beltless 3D Inducer motor, a telescoping wand and five height positions. Expect to pay between $200 and $500.

The top spot comes from combining the best filtration with the least maintenance. Compared with the 400 Series canister, it handles carpet better but is heavier to carry and less nimble on stairs.

It suits households with carpet and pets that want fewer belt swaps. The caveat is price, since it costs more than any other upright here.
products.idealFor: Carpeted homes with pets and allergy concerns.
products.skipIf: You mostly clean bare floors or stairs.

products.name: Kenmore 81414 400 Series Pet Friendly Lightweight Bagged Canister Vacuum
products.verdict: A HEPA canister with an extended wand, retractable cord and four tools.
products.description:
The 81414 is a lightweight bagged canister with HEPA filtration, an extended telescoping wand, a retractable cord and four cleaning tools. It sits in the $200-500 bracket.

It ranks second because the kit is complete, but it has no upright brushroll width for big carpets. Against the 200 Series it adds a retractable cord and one more tool for the extra money.

Choose it for mixed floors, stairs and above-floor cleaning. The caveat is that a canister means dragging a body behind you.
products.idealFor: Homes with stairs and mixed flooring.
products.skipIf: You want one machine for wall-to-wall carpet.

products.name: Kenmore 81214 200 Series Pet Friendly Lightweight Bagged Canister Vacuum
products.verdict: The cheapest route to HEPA and a two-motor canister.
products.description:
The 81214 is a bagged canister with HEPA filtration, a 2 Motor System and three cleaning tools. It sits in the $100-200 bracket, one step below the 400 Series.

It ranks third because it drops a tool and the extended wand of the model above while saving a price bracket. Against the Hair Eliminator upright, it gives you HEPA and a separate suction motor.

It fits budget buyers who want filtration first. The caveat is that three tools cover the basics only.
products.idealFor: Budget shoppers who want HEPA filtration.
products.skipIf: You need the longest reach or most tools.

products.name: Kenmore Intuition Bagged Upright Vacuum with Hair Eliminator Brushroll
products.verdict: An upright built to cut down on hair wrapping the brushroll.
products.description:
This Intuition upright is a bagged model with a Hair Eliminator brushroll, sitting in the $100-200 bracket. The listing gives few other specs.

It ranks fourth because it lacks HEPA and a canister's reach, but it solves the common chore of cutting hair off a brushroll. Compared with the Elite, it is much cheaper and far less equipped.

It suits long-haired or shedding households on carpet. The caveat is the thin spec sheet: check filtration details on the listing before buying.

products.name: Kenmore 600 Series Pet Friendly Bagged Canister Vacuum
products.verdict: Kenmore's top canister line, though the listing is short on detail.
products.description:
The 600 Series is a pet friendly bagged canister in the $200-500 bracket. The available spec detail is limited to the series and pet-friendly design.

It ranks last because we cannot confirm the filtration, tool count or motor setup that the 400 Series lists. Against that cheaper-looking kit, you pay for the series name more than for proven extras.

It fits buyers who specifically want the 600 line. The caveat is that you should read the listing for details before committing.
products.idealFor: Buyers loyal to the 600 Series line.
products.skipIf: You want confirmed HEPA and tool counts.

whatMatters.detail: HEPA filters capture very fine dust that standard filters let back into the room. This matters for allergies and pets because a bagged vacuum can still leak without it. Look for the word HEPA in the title or bullets, not just 'allergen' wording.
Uprights clean carpet fast with a wide brushroll. Canisters are lighter in the hand and reach stairs, furniture and ceilings. Match the style to your floors before comparing anything else.
Belts stretch and break, then need a replacement and a quick repair. A beltless design avoids that. Check the listing for beltless or 3D Inducer wording.
Long hair wraps around a brushroll and can stall it. Brushrolls with a hair-cutting feature cut cleaning time. Look for the Hair Eliminator or similar name.
Tools and wands decide whether the vacuum cleans stairs and corners. Check the number of tools and whether the wand telescopes.

faq.a: They hold suction better as the bag fills than many bagless models, but a very full bag does reduce airflow. Replace it before it is packed.

faq.q: Are any of these compatible with any bag?
faq.a: Kenmore uses specific bag types by model. Check the listing for the exact bag number before buying.

faq.q: Is the Elite worth it over the 400 Series?
faq.a: Only if you have carpet. The 400 Series is lighter and better for stairs.
Attach the wand and tools and fit the bag. Most models need no tools.

faq.q: How do I maintain HEPA filters?
faq.a: Replace them on the schedule in the manual and never wash a paper HEPA unless it says so.
Canisters with a floor tool are gentler. Use the height setting on the upright.

finalTake: The Kenmore Elite 31150 is the best bagged Kenmore for most carpeted homes. The 400 Series is the one to buy if stairs and mixed floors dominate, and the 200 Series is the best cheap HEPA entry. The 600 Series needs its listing read closely before you spend.
